summary: Standards pass: atip.optionforms.12 says a date or time that does not exist is refused 'with its cause', but the test only asserts parse_date_time/parse return Err (never that TimestampError source is Some), and the real binary prints 'want an RFC 3339 date-time ...' for 2026-02-30T10:00:00Z with no word that the date does not exist (same text shape as 0.36.0: 'want RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD'); blast radius: the 12 time options' refusal text for calendar-impossible values, which atip_optionforms_08 checks by code and field only. Non-blocking.
